state.review: Re-evaluate selected choreography rows using only their material source/target facts and proof rules. A dispatcher is not proof of target commitment. Do not require child-stage proofs where the selected row has no intermediate stage; judge the row kind and its actual conditions.

ownerFacts.identity: Caller TenantId is immutable tenant creation identity; lifecycle operations use caller CommandId.
ownerFacts.invariant: One tenant lifecycle activates only after its slug and first-administrator conditions; offboarding forbids new active service; one current slug transition admitted at a time.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Tenant lifecycle and activation/current-slug link need coherence; global slug uniqueness belongs slug authority. Previous slug history and transport correlation need not live in tenant.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of tenant + role + normalized permission. Selected CommandId and assignment episode bind the exact assignment/removal intent.
ownerFacts.invariant: One normalized role-permission tuple has a single active relationship at a time.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Relationship can be assigned/removed without serializing unrelated permissions; a roster in Role is unnecessary.

ownerFacts.identity: Existing UUIDv5 of tenant + team + member. Each assignment episode remains exact; selected native operation/receiver identity is bound to that member/team episode.
ownerFacts.invariant: One tenant/team/member relationship is active only for one current membership episode.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Membership episode and active flag must be together; team-wide roster does not need an atomic revision. Tenant-manager invariant requires separate authoritative removal coordination.

ownerFacts.identity: Tenant / existing EvidenceStreams artifact key / ArtifactId, with immutable source identity and verified content binding. ArtifactId identifies registration; selected mutations use CommandId. Download grants use the separately adopted artifact-qualified receiving identity.
ownerFacts.invariant: Immutable content remains unavailable until clean inspection; malware alone can be released with attributed clean rescan; secret/invalid rejection is final.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Inspection and quarantine release share availability decision. Download authorization needs an admission proof against that decision but every historical download need not extend artifact lifecycle stream.

ownerFacts.identity: UUIDv5 namespace ArtifactId, UTF8 artifact-download-grant:v1:{canonical TenantId}:{canonical CommandId}. Receiving root additionally verifies exact artifact/command/original-actor tuple. No generic operation lookup.
ownerFacts.invariant: One exact receiving grant owns the authenticated encrypted original artifact ticket/result after EvidenceArtifact first admitted and pinned availability with frozen202. Complete required held source uses and exact issue DecisionAt precede native issued-v2; cancellation fences delayed issuance and terminal proofs settle all uses. Original expiry never renews under the same root identity. Existing artifact-issued v1 decoder remains read-only compatibility.

orderedPhysicalPlans.execution: One reactor processes the command list serially; each send completes before the next command is sent.
orderedPhysicalPlans.condition: ownerBecomesAdministrator = CreatorIsAdministrator OR FirstAdministratorEmail is null.

orderedEffects.intent: Register the tenant owner for the administrator episode.
Link the administrators team to the administrator role.
Commit all three core administrator permissions.
Assign the exact owner member to the administrators team; TeamMemberAssigned can trigger tenant activation.

orderedPhysicalPlans.activationFence: The order-6 TeamMemberAssigned effect is forbidden until the order-4 TeamRoleAssigned fact and all three order-5 RolePermissionAssigned facts have committed for this same tenant registration and administrator role.
orderedPhysicalPlans.failureBehavior: Any prerequisite send failure stops before activation assignment; activation assignment failure fails the reactor invocation and prevents its checkpoint from completing. Replays reuse the same source-derived command identities.

flows.proofGate: Use canonical built-in IDs and source-derived relationship command IDs. Register owner only when selected as first administrator; bind its registration episode. Administrative role link and core permissions precede activation-triggering assignment; guarded admin assignment retains its source-admission process.
flows.recoveryContract: Replayed bootstrap allows existing role/team-definition conflicts as explicitly coded; other effects retry identical deterministic identities. Never manufacture a missing permission or membership result.

Exact source/generation fence before source-use release, including not-yet-acquired keys where selected. Published/irreversible outcomes recover forward; unknown append/unavailable remains transient; no unproven absence or clear-all release.

fieldsInOrder: episode (exact selected value, initial when absent)
effectIdentity.rule: Use only for this new unoccupied process identity domain; occupied v1 algorithms/target-key selections remain unchanged. Implementation must provide fixed byte/UUID vectors before activation.

flows.abortAuthority: Actual provable pre-issue expiry/revocation/conflict/terminal failure bound to accepted root and complete held/not-yet-held key set; no cancellation from unavailable body alone. Atomically fence receiving issue before any settlement. Already issued recovers forward.

selectedContract.guards: Only before EvidenceArtifactDownloadIssued; prove expired/revoked/conflicting required source or invalid/unavailable ticket outcome. Atomically fence grant issuance before source use settlement, including not-yet-acquired uses. Already issued grant cannot renew or change result; release uses from its exact issued fact.
tests: ticket encrypted before native append crash

expectedRevisionScope.counter: No primary caller ResourceRevision. Enforce required authored source/epoch/version tokens, immutable creation identity or trusted proof/generation as declared; append uses physical OCC.
